title: Young people gathered to pilot craft at black facilities

tellings.quote: of these wild stories about, you know, how very young people are being basically uh, you know, selected and and uh, you know, gathered together from various parts of the world and brought to these black facilities so that they can more effectively pilot these craft, right?

related.note: Both say a program recruits young people from around the world. This telling says children from native cultures are recruited as psionic assets to lure UFOs, while the story says they are gathered to pilot craft at black facilities.

plain: Very young people are said to be picked out from around the world and brought to secret, unacknowledged military sites, so-called black facilities, where they can fly unusual craft better than adults can. The philosopher Jason Jorjani repeats this as one of the "wild stories" he has heard, without naming who told him. If true, it would mean a hidden program to train children to pilot these craft.
